title: Practice 8: либо, или … или, то … то, не то … не то

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: A group of languages related via a common ancestor, or proto-language, is referred to as a language family.
exercises.ru: Группа языков, связанных общим языком-предком, ___ протоязыком, называется языковой семьёй.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Is it a compliment or an insult?
exercises.ru: Это комплимент ___ оскорбление?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Some people dance with a mop or a broom for some reason.
exercises.ru: Некоторые люди зачем-то танцуют со шваброй ___ метлой.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Smoking or nonsmoking?
exercises.ru: Для курящих ___ некурящих?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Cats love to play, jump, and roam around the house or yard.
exercises.ru: Кошки любят играть, прыгать и рыскать по дому ___ двору.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Can you play the viola, too, or do you only play violin?
exercises.ru: А ты на альте играть тоже умеешь, ___ только на скрипке?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Are you a liberal or conservative?
exercises.ru: Вы либерал ___ консерватор?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Did you come to the university library to check out books or just cute college girls?
exercises.ru: Ты в университетскую библиотеку зашёл за книгами ___ так, девчонок поразглядывать?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Are you for or against abortions?
exercises.ru: Ты за ___ против абортов?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Is it more difficult for English speakers to pronounce the German word for squirrel, or for German speakers to pronounce the English one?
exercises.ru: Что сложнее: англофонам произнести немецкое название белки ___ германофонам – английское?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: In this country, any fool can be a governor, a representative or a senator.
exercises.ru: В этой стране любой дурак — губернатор, депутат ___ сенатор.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which is healthier: rice or buckwheat?
exercises.ru: Что полезнее: рис ___ гречка?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A proto-language is the common ancestor of a group of languages or dialects.
exercises.ru: Праязык — это общий предок группы языков ___ диалектов.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Would you rather eat a mouse or a tarantula?
exercises.ru: Что бы ты предпочёл съесть — мышь ___ тарантула?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Shark soup or whale steak? You have the choice.
exercises.ru: Акулий суп ___ китовый стейк? У тебя есть выбор.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It is either Cesar or nothing.
exercises.ru: ___ Цезарь, или ничто.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Did you give birth at home or at a maternity hospital?
exercises.ru: Вы рожали дома ___ в родильном доме?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Are you Dutch or Spanish?
exercises.ru: Вы голландка ___ испанка?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: For here or to go?
exercises.ru: Вам здесь ___ на вынос?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Olympus? Isn't that where Greek gods hang out or something?
exercises.ru: Олимп? Это где греческие боги тусуются, ___ что?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
